component.name: Opaline
component.summary: Glass widgets for your Ubuntu desktop

description.p: Opaline brings customizable glass widgets to the Ubuntu 26.04 / GNOME 50 desktop. Place, move, resize, and stack live widgets right on your wallpaper — above desktop icons and below application windows, across multiple monitors.

Includes fourteen built-in widgets (Clock, CPU, Memory, GPU, Storage, Network, Battery & Power, Fans, Processes, Now Playing, Audio Visualizer, Weather, Calendar, and Docker), dynamic Material 3 Expressive themes, Peek and Edit modes, and zero telemetry.

Opaline 1.0.0: fourteen customizable glass widgets, Native GNOME 50 Wayland and Instant Xwayland desktop integration, Android-style Edit mode with stacks and presets, Settings and Onboarding, verified updates, and English, German, and Arabic (RTL) support.
